# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Issues

Excel Masters takes security seriously. If you discover a vulnerability or security risk across any of our web platforms, backend bots, or services, please report it privately:

- ✉️ **Email**: [kukzze@excelmasters.in](mailto:kukzze@excelmasters.in)

Please include a detailed description of the vulnerability, affected components, and steps to reproduce. We will respond promptly and coordinate a patch before public disclosure.
